QC1.title: Premium services, sixth slot a gold question mark
QC1.brief: Template I50b (cream list), without its per-row fee tags. 0.0: heading 'प्रीमियम सेवाएँ' already set. 0.15-0.75: rows 01 लीगल असिस्टेंस, 02 अकाउंटिंग और फ़ाइनेंशियल मॉनिटरिंग, 03 साइबर सिक्योरिटी, 04 क्विक रिस्पॉन्स सर्विस, 05 स्टाफ़ असेसमेंट slide in 0.15 s apart. 1.55 (on 'अलग से'): footnote fades in, 'फ़ीस — ज़रूरत के हिसाब से'. 2.70: row 06 draws in as an empty gold dashed slot, '06 · ?'. 2.90 (on 'छठी'): the '?' pops and pulses once. Hold to 3.84 (through 'सेवा?'). Never names the sixth service or its terms.

QC2.title: DSR + stock ready (P02 variant)
QC2.brief: Variant of P02, built in the P02 panel template: the finished phone (कल की बिक्री 4,222 L, टंकी में अभी 14,246 L, कल आया 6,000 L) as its final frame, slow push-in on the three big rows. Added in the design system, in the empty dark top of the phone screen above the DSR header: cream pill with maroon text 'डी-एस-आर' from 0.0; at 0.97 (on 'स्टॉक') '· स्टॉक' slides in beside it, so it reads 'डी-एस-आर · स्टॉक'. Check the final frame for clashes with the header.

QC3.title: Compliance score (P10 variant)
QC3.brief: Variant of P10, built in the P10 panel template: the finished phone with 98% and the 'उदाहरण' tag kept, held with a slow push-in. Added in the design system, in the cream margin above the phone (scale the phone to about 92% if the pill needs the room): maroon pill with cream text 'कंप्लायंस स्कोर', in from 0.0. Check the final frame.

QE1.title: End card: the answer is in the full film
QE1.brief: Template I76 (cream paper, gold M) with I74's flat maroon label pill. From 0.0: footer with gold M mark and 'एम-डी-जी सर्विसेज़ · डीलर कवच'. 0.0-0.5: 'छठी सेवा का जवाब —' in gold, word by word. 0.6: maroon label pill 'पूरी फ़िल्म देखें' (no ▶, no shadow, so it reads as an instruction, not a button). 0.9: gold chip '26 मिनट'. 1.2: 'mdgservices.in/film', the biggest and clearest line on the card. Fully static from 1.4 to 3.23, so the last frame carries the whole call to action when forwarded.

QC4.title: The shortfall, large (I95a top band variant)
QC4.brief: I95a's opening state only — greyed tanker outline with the 'लोड रुका' pause chip, the bar 'लोड उठाने के लिए ज़रूरी रक़म' and the hatched gap '₹1–3 लाख कम' — enlarged about 1.6x and centred in the upper two-thirds; nothing below it. The hatched gap and its '₹1–3 लाख कम' label wipe in over 0.9–1.4 s (on 'एक से तीन लाख', spoken 1.06–1.89 s into the card); hold to the end.
